description: This Java class `MongoSearchUpdaterFlow` defines an Akka Streams flow for batching and updating documents in a MongoDB collection related to 'thing search' persistence. It manages bulk write operations with concurrency control and timing metrics, and assembles complex stream processing graph components for efficient database interactions.

classes.name: MongoSearchUpdaterFlow
classes.description: Final class implementing an Akka Streams flow component for batched MongoDB updates related to 'thing search' persistence.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of `MongoSearchUpdaterFlow` for a given MongoDatabase.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Creates an Akka Streams Flow that processes sources of `AbstractWriteModel` objects, batching them and performing bulk write operations with concurrency and timing metrics.

methods.name: executeBulkWrite
methods.description: Performs a bulk write operation on the MongoDB collection with the provided list of write models, returning a source of write results or errors.

methods.name: createStartTimerFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow that starts a timer and records the number of write models being processed.

methods.name: createStopTimerFlow
methods.description: Creates a flow that stops the timer started upstream, handling already-stopped scenarios gracefully.

methods.name: assembleFlows
methods.description: Builds an Akka Streams graph combining multiple flows for processing, timing, and result aggregation.
